task.title: Ejecutar un escenario de import, review, export y compliance handoff
task.shortdesc: Use existing health, import, validation, profile, and export APIs to hand off a reviewed Firefox document with compliance evidence.

prereq.p: Set $BPM_BASE_URL, choose the schema channel, and decide which system owns the source document, compliance scan result, reviewer approval, exported artifact, and recovery decision.

context.p: This scenario uses API-HEALTH-001, API-HEALTH-002, API-FF-001, API-PROFILE-003, API-VAL-001, and API-FF-002. BPM stores the normalized profile and opaque compliance metadata; the integrating product owns scan interpretation and downstream deployment.

step.cmd: Start with health and readiness before the handoff sequence.

info.p: Request examples: GET $BPM_BASE_URL/health and GET $BPM_BASE_URL/health/ready. Response examples: 200 {"status":"ok"} and 200 {"status":"ready","ready":true}. Error example: transport or gateway failure is handled outside BPM because no application error is currently declared.

step.cmd: Import the reviewed Firefox document with compliance metadata attached to the BPM profile.

info.p: Request example: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/import/firefox/policies.json with JSON {"name":"reviewed-corp-baseline","schema_version":"release-152","compliance":{"scanner":"external-control","result":"passed","ticket":"SEC-42"},"document":{"policies":{"DisableTelemetry":true,"BlockAboutConfig":true}}}. Response example: 201 ProfileRead. Error examples: 400, 409, 415, or 422.

step.cmd: Read the created profile and record BPM ownership fields separately from external evidence.

info.p: Request example: GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/42. Response example: 200 ProfileRead with id, revision, flags, schema_version, and opaque compliance. Error examples: 404 or 422.

step.cmd: Validate the canonical Firefox document that will be handed off.

info.p: Request example: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/validate/release-152 with JSON {"document":{"policies":{"DisableTelemetry":true,"BlockAboutConfig":true}}}. Response example: 200 {"ok":true,"profile":"release-152"}. Error examples: 400, 404, 422, or 503.

step.cmd: Export the BPM profile as the canonical Firefox deployment document.

info.p: Request example: GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/export/profiles/42/firefox/policies.json?download=1&pretty=1. Response example: 200 application/json with Content-Disposition and top-level policies. BPM profile metadata and compliance metadata are not exported.

step.cmd: Stop on mismatches and write the failure recovery record.

info.note: If import, validation, read-back, or export evidence differs from the approved source document, do not retry blindly. Store source hash, profile ID, revision, validation body, export hash, scanner result, reviewer, response status, and the recovery decision outside BPM.

result.p: The integrating product has an executable import-review-export flow with compliance handoff, canonical export, and explicit recovery evidence.

postreq.p: Use deployment tooling outside BPM to apply the exported policies.json; BPM validation does not prove Firefox runtime enforcement.
